name: How do I know if I need a single line water re-pipe?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a single line water re-pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs you might need a single line water re-pipe include consistently low water pressure throughout your home, recurring leaks in your main water line, discolored or rusty water coming from your taps, or a sudden increase in your water bill without a change in usage. If your home has older galvanized steel or polybutylene pipes, which are prone to deterioration, replacement is often a proactive measure to prevent future problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for low water pressure, frequent main line leaks, discolored water, or an unexpected jump in your water bill.
